name: Magic Dock
tagline: A new Mac Dock with widgets, themes and workspaces.
description: Your Mac’s Dock can do more than launch apps. Magic Dock brings music with synced lyrics, calendar, weather, files, clipboard history and system stats right beside the apps you already use. Choose from 76 widgets and 14 themes to build a Dock that works and feels like yours. Create separate workspaces for work, study, design or music, each with its own apps, folders, links and widgets, and switch with a keyboard shortcut. Try Magic Dock free for 48 hours, with no card required, at https://magicdock.app/. Follow Claude Code sessions from the Dock and see when they finish. Requires macOS 14.5 or later. Regular price: US$15 lifetime or US$3/month for up to two Macs.
